competitiveTarget: Beat Zillow / Redfin / Coldwell Banker community pages — the kinetic-brutalist homepage look applied at resort / master-planned community scope: live single-family market data, the in-community listing map + zoom, per-community featured tours, sub-neighborhoods, open houses, and live activity no competitor surfaces, paired with authored local knowledge (HOA + club dues, amenities, drive times).
note: KB (kinetic-brutalist) design language — Phase 9 wave 2 (docs/KB_CONVERGENCE_ROADMAP.md). The community page reuses the SAME section library as the homepage and the city page (components/site/kb/*), fed community-scoped DAL data, never forked (ci:kb-single-source G50). KbNav + KbFooter carry chrome (default SiteHeader/SiteFooter hidden for ^/communities/[slug] via HideChrome). Body lives in main.kb-root. THE PAGE CONTRACT: KB design + SEO for Google & LLMs (pageMetadata + MetadataBlock JSON-LD: Breadcrumb/Place/Dataset/FAQPage) + tracking (KbSectionTracker). Supersedes the Experience System Geo archetype v3.1; every former section (FlyoverHero, LiveMarketBand, SectionNav, CommunityMapLedgerPane + ListingLedger, PriceHistoryScrubber, PaymentSlider, PriceRangeTiles, RelatedAreas, ActivityFeed, ArticleGrid, InlineValuationHook, PageBreadcrumb) was rebuilt in KB form.
